label: Areesh
note: Made from skimmed soured milk, so not a whole-milk cheese like Tvorog

about.text: An Egyptian fresh cheese of skimmed buffalo or cow milk: the milk is fermented to laban rayeb, gently heated so the curd separates, and drained. Eaten with honey or tomatoes and herbs, and the base of mish.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.

how.label: heat the laban rayeb gently
how.text: The soured skimmed milk is heated gently until the curd separates, then drained.
